nodes.description: Ownable.owner: address of the contract owner, set from msg.sender in the constructor and used by the onlyOwner modifier.
Ownable.manager: privileged address allowed to call manager-restricted functions such as mint().
Ownable.pendingOwner: address that can finalize the ownership transfer via claimOwnership().
ERC721BasicToken.tokenOwner: mapping from token ID to its current owner address.
ERC721BasicToken.tokenApprovals: mapping from token ID to the single approved address.
ERC721BasicToken.ownedTokensCount: mapping from owner address to the number of tokens held.
ERC721BasicToken.operatorApprovals: nested mapping of owner to operator approval flags.
SupportsInterfaceWithLookup.supportedInterfaces: mapping of ERC165 interface id to support flag.
GeneralSecurityToken.tokenIDCount: monotonically increasing counter used as the next token ID.
GeneralSecurityToken.ownedTokens: mapping from owner address to the array of owned token IDs used for enumeration.
GeneralSecurityToken.allTokens: array containing every minted token ID.
GeneralSecurityToken.tokenURIs: mapping from token ID to its metadata URI string.
GeneralSecurityToken.tokenData: mapping from token ID to the Data struct holding 'information' and 'URL' strings.
Ownable.transferOwnership(address newOwner): onlyOwner function that stages a new pending owner.
Ownable.claimOwnership(): onlyPendingOwner function that completes the ownership handover.
Ownable.setManager(address _manager): onlyOwner function that sets the privileged manager address.
GeneralSecurityToken.mint(address _to): onlyManager external function that mints a token with id tokenIDCount++.
GeneralSecurityToken.addTokenData(uint _tokenId, string _information, string _URL): public function gated by require(ownerOf(_tokenId) == msg.sender) that stores per-token data.
GeneralSecurityToken.getTokenData(uint _tokenId): public view returning the stored licence information and URL.
GeneralSecurityToken anonymous payable fallback: requires msg.value > 0.16 ether and mints a token to msg.sender using tokenIDCount++.
ERC721BasicToken.approve(address _to, uint256 _tokenId): sets token approval after ownership/operator checks.
ERC721BasicToken.setApprovalForAll(address _to, bool _approved): grants blanket operator approval to _to.
ERC721BasicToken.transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint256 _tokenId): guarded by canTransfer, clears approval, removes the token from the sender and adds it to the receiver.
ERC721BasicToken.safeTransferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint256 _tokenId, bytes _data): performs transferFrom followed by the ERC721 receiver check.
addTokenTo(address _to, uint256 _tokenId): assigns tokenOwner, increments ownedTokensCount via SafeMath and pushes the token into ownedTokens.
removeTokenFrom(address _from, uint256 _tokenId): decrements ownedTokensCount via SafeMath, clears tokenOwner and swaps/removes the token from the owner's array.
_mint(address _to, uint256 _id): pushes the id into allTokens, records the index and delegates to the base _mint/addTokenTo.
checkAndCallSafeTransfer(...): if the target is a contract it performs the ERC721 receiver callback and validates the magic return value.
isApprovedOrOwner(address _spender, uint256 _tokenId): returns whether the spender is owner, approved or an operator.
ERC721BasicToken.ownerOf(uint256 _tokenId): reads tokenOwner and requires a non-zero owner.
ERC721BasicToken.balanceOf(address _owner): returns ownedTokensCount for a non-zero address.
msg.sender: externally controlled caller address used for owner, manager, pending-owner, approval and minting checks.
ERC721Receiver(_to).onERC721Received(_from, _tokenId, _data): external call to an attacker-controlled contract during safeTransferFrom, enabling reentrancy.
tokenIDCount++ used as the minted token id in mint() and the payable fallback: unchecked post-increment arithmetic on the global id counter.
Parameter newOwner of transferOwnership(address newOwner).
Parameter _manager of setManager(address _manager).
Parameter _to of mint(address _to).
Parameter _tokenId of addTokenData(uint _tokenId, string _information, string _URL).
Parameter _information of addTokenData, stored into tokenData[_tokenId].information.
Parameter _URL of addTokenData, stored into tokenData[_tokenId].URL.
Parameter _tokenId of getTokenData(uint _tokenId).
Parameter _to of approve(address _to, uint256 _tokenId).
Parameter _tokenId of approve(address _to, uint256 _tokenId).
Parameter _from of transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint256 _tokenId).
Parameter _to of transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint256 _tokenId).
Parameter _tokenId of transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint256 _tokenId).
Parameter _to of checkAndCallSafeTransfer / safeTransferFrom, used as the external call target.
Parameter _data of safeTransferFrom/checkAndCallSafeTransfer forwarded to the receiver callback.
Local variable owner in approve(): cached result of ownerOf(_tokenId).
Local variable tokenIndex in removeTokenFrom(): position of the token in the owner's array.
Local variable lastTokenIndex in removeTokenFrom(): index of the last element (computed with SafeMath.sub).
Local variable retval in checkAndCallSafeTransfer(): bytes4 result of the external onERC721Received call.

edges.reason: The constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, so an untrusted caller becomes the privileged owner at deployment.
transferOwnership reads owner to enforce the onlyOwner modifier.
msg.sender must equal owner for transferOwnership to proceed.
newOwner is written into the pendingOwner state variable.
msg.sender must equal pendingOwner for claimOwnership to proceed.
msg.sender must equal owner for setManager to proceed.
_manager is validated against address(0) and stored in the manager state variable.
The onlyManager modifier compares msg.sender with manager before minting.
_to is the beneficiary passed to the internal mint routine.
mint reads and post-increments tokenIDCount to derive the new token id.
tokenIDCount is the operand of the unchecked post-increment operation.
The incremented counter value is supplied as the id argument to _mint.
The payable fallback mints to msg.sender, allowing any caller to become a token owner for the required payment.
msg.sender is passed as the _to argument of _mint from the fallback function.
The fallback uses tokenIDCount++ as the minted token id.
_tokenId selects the entry of tokenData written by addTokenData.
_information is stored into tokenData[_tokenId].information.
_URL is stored into tokenData[_tokenId].URL.
addTokenData requires ownerOf(_tokenId) == msg.sender before writing token data.
The ownership check in addTokenData resolves through tokenOwner via ownerOf.
_tokenId selects which tokenData entry getTokenData returns.
getTokenData reads the information and URL fields from tokenData.
_to is the address granted approval in approve.
_tokenId is the token whose approval is modified in approve.
The cached local owner is compared with msg.sender and _to inside approve.
approve requires msg.sender to be the token owner or an approved operator.
approve writes the approved address into tokenApprovals.
setApprovalForAll writes the operator flag into operatorApprovals[msg.sender][_to].
_from is the current owner whose token is removed during transferFrom.
_to is the recipient that receives the token during transferFrom.
_tokenId identifies the transfered token and drives the canTransfer modifier.
The canTransfer modifier passes msg.sender into isApprovedOrOwner before the transfer executes.
transferFrom invokes removeTokenFrom for the sender.
transferFrom invokes addTokenTo for the receiver.
addTokenTo writes the new owner into tokenOwner[_tokenId].
addTokenTo increments ownedTokensCount[_to] using SafeMath.add.
The overridden addTokenTo pushes the token id into ownedTokens[_to].
removeTokenFrom decrements ownedTokensCount[_from] via SafeMath.sub(1).
removeTokenFrom resets tokenOwner[_tokenId] to address(0).
removeTokenFrom rewrites and shortens the ownedTokens[_from] array.
tokenIndex drives the array swap performed by removeTokenFrom.
lastTokenIndex is produced by ownedTokens[_from].length.sub(1) in removeTokenFrom.
_mint delegates ownership bookkeeping to addTokenTo.
The overridden _mint pushes the id into allTokens and stores its index.
safeTransferFrom calls transferFrom before validating the receiver.
safeTransferFrom calls checkAndCallSafeTransfer, which reaches the external receiver callback after state changes.
checkAndCallSafeTransfer executes the external onERC721Received call on the untrusted target contract.
_to, a caller-controlled address, is the target of the external call.
_data is forwarded as attacker-controlled calldata to the receiver callback.
The receiver contract can re-enter checkAndCallSafeTransfer (and thus transferFrom) while the transfer is still in progress.
The returned magic value retval is compared against ERC721_RECEIVED in checkAndCallSafeTransfer.
isApprovedOrOwner calls ownerOf(_tokenId) to resolve the current owner.
ownerOf reads the owner from tokenOwner[_tokenId].
balanceOf returns the value stored in ownedTokensCount[_owner].

normalization_plan.reason: newOwner is a parameter used only to update pendingOwner inside transferOwnership; fold it into the transferOwnership function node.
_manager is a parameter consumed only by setManager when assigning the manager state variable.
_to of mint() is only forwarded to the internal mint routine and carries no independent behaviour.
_tokenId of addTokenData only selects the tokenData slot written by addTokenData.
_information is written straight into tokenData by addTokenData and has no standalone semantics.
_URL is written straight into tokenData by addTokenData and has no standalone semantics.
_tokenId of getTokenData only indexes the mapping read by getTokenData.
_to of approve is only stored into tokenApprovals inside approve.
_tokenId of approve only selects the approval slot written by approve.
_from of transferFrom is only used as the removal source inside transferFrom.
_to of transferFrom is only used as the addition destination inside transferFrom.
_tokenId of transferFrom only parametrises the transfer and the canTransfer guard.
_to is the untrusted callee address of the external onERC721Received invocation, so it belongs to that unsafe operation.
_data is attacker-controlled calldata passed to the external onERC721Received invocation.
The local owner is a cached ownerOf result used only for the access checks inside approve.
tokenIndex is a temporary index used only by the array manipulation in removeTokenFrom.
lastTokenIndex is a SafeMath-derived temporary used only by removeTokenFrom.
retval holds the bytes4 result of the external receiver call and is consumed solely by checkAndCallSafeTransfer.
